test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Integrated Tribal Development Project (ITDP) comes into existence as a part of the _______ Five-Year Plan.
solution:
Correct answer is __**Fifth.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Integrated Tribal Development Programme **was previously started in 1974 with the **Fifth Five Year Plan.**
 
• The Integrated Tribal Development Projects (ITDP) **under Tribal Sub-Plan** (TSP) is being execute since the Fifth Five Year Plan.
 
• The Integrated Tribal Development Project (I.T.D.P),** Rayagada take in** of Rayagada Block came into existence on the **29th of August 1974**.
 
• The Tribal Development Blocks were launched **for the development of tribal areas**.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c041eaafc686403baceaa6909134a4d97fb8fb7bb9a2dd468063074aa95bed54.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Second Plan concentrated** on the development of the public sector and "rapid Industrialisation"**. 
 
• The five-year plan is **a method of planning economic extensions over limited periods by the use of quotas**.
 
• The Sixth Five-Year Plan decided** the start of economic liberalisation**. ​
